info.description:
Published snapshots only. Draft and pending content and media require ownership or administrator access. Error messages are localized by clients using error.code. Resource snapshots have independent review and processing states; anonymous media access also requires a public parent showroom and linked product. Platform operators use effective feature permissions. Administrator-only storage, persistent jobs and encrypted isolated recovery are provided. Anonymous analytics do not identify people.
Public data reads use shared per-IP page/API limits, bounded pagination and distinct content budgets; 429 includes Retry-After. Schema14 preserves historical showroom addresses. Schema18 compacts the official product taxonomy to 10 roots and 35 children; existing IDs resolve through aliases. Search UI removes industrial belt and business nature while APIs preserve legacy filter compatibility. Schema19 adds globally unique verified account phones and purpose-scoped verification; legacy username and SMS endpoints remain compatible. Native App removes map functionality; website maps remain available.

post.description: Maximum 100 operations. Each operation_id belongs to the current account and must never be reused for another payload. bearerAuth.description: Opaque session token; 30 day expiration; revoked on logout

company_profile.description: Optional versioned vendor profile. Omission or null on draft updates preserves the latest stored profile for legacy clients; use an empty object to clear. Image references must belong to the vendor owner and remain versioned.

region_code.description: Optional validated city/county administrative code from the bundled 2023 directory. The server derives region_id and region_name. Omit for legacy ID or manual-text input.

industrial_belt_ids.description: Administrator-maintained membership, inherited from the public manufacturer for products.

Payload.description: Schema17/18 agriculture classification: drafts may omit classifications. New agriculture manufacturers require one primary category when submitted; new products require one product category. Up to two distinct secondary manufacturer categories. New product selections use leaves of a tree of at most three levels. Pre-upgrade content retains its historical classification. Omitted new fields on updates are preserved; explicit zero, empty string or empty array clears the field. Legacy category_id and parameters are retained. Approval and ownership rules are unchanged.

public_visible.description: Actual public access, including the parent booth visibility gate

vendor.description: Included in public product list items.

published.description: Administrator-only current published snapshot, retained while editing or reviewing.

hall_id.description: Owning hall. Products inherit the manufacturer hall.

fields.description: Optional compatible field validation details; error.code remains available.

phone.description: Verified mainland China mobile number; never inferred from company contacts.

product_count.description: Complete public count including descendants, independent of pagination.

code.description: Immutable unique seed code; IDs are generated by the database.

search_aliases.description: Comma-separated or newline-separated category search aliases, up to 3000 UTF-8 bytes.

administrative_code.description: Optional unique administrative code; existing region IDs are retained.

hall_id.description: Optional for a new manufacturer; omitted defaults to hall 1. Products always inherit their manufacturer hall.

VendorSummary.description: Published vendor name and region; never a draft snapshot.

hall_id.description: Optional for a new manufacturer; omitted defaults to hall 1. Products always inherit their manufacturer hall.

AdminVendorCreate.description: Either link an existing unassigned merchant account_id, or create a unique login_name. Account and booth are created atomically. New accounts receive a random password; only its hash is stored.

initial_password.description: Present only in this creation response for a newly created company account. Never retrievable from lists, details or logs.

credentials.description: Qualification/award order; omitted or null preserves existing entries on draft save, explicit [] clears. Chinese title must not be blank. Reviewed with the company revision.

gallery_annotations.description: Captions keyed by media_id in media_ids. media_ids determines order. Omitted/null preserves captions for remaining images; [] clears captions.

representative_products.description: Up to 3 public snapshots in configured order, independent of catalog filters. Manual empty selection hides the section.

business_category.description: Published company operating category, including its own approved supplemental category; canonical aliases resolved.

home_products.description: Homepage only: configured representatives first, then published products of this vendor, at most eight; manual empty selection stays empty. Original representative_products contract remains unchanged.

ResourcePayload.description: Product demonstrations require an owned product. PDF/video use file_media_id; image catalogs use ordered page_media_ids. Optional English fields fall back to Chinese. Covers and pages must be owned images.

password.description: Required only in manual mode. 12–72 UTF-8 bytes, not all whitespace. Spaces are preserved; generate mode rejects a supplied password.
New password returned once by this endpoint only. Not persisted by clients.

visitor_id.description: First-party anonymous ID; do not send account, phone or email.

page.description: Normalized public path without query, credentials or fragment.

referrer.description: Optional origin only; server retains hostname.

endpoint.description: HTTPS Alibaba Cloud endpoint without path/query.

access_key_id.description: Write-only. Leave both credential fields empty to preserve.
